separation.method: Background reconstruction and transparent static/foreground extraction with built-in image generation. Animation sheets generated independently; then mechanically split, uniformly fit to padded cells and packed.
separation.limitation: This is an illustrated reconstruction. Inpainted/occluded scenery and some painted contours differ from the source; pixel-perfect reconstruction is not claimed.
separation.animatedVines: Only the separate long hanging strands move. Short attached stone ivy is static.
separation.effectsNotExplicitlyVisible: Magical motes are a subtle optional requested effect. Disable their instances if strict reference-only atmosphere is desired.
separation.lake: No new lake. Water-surface effect is placed only at the lower cascade basin.
